newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends up in active trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends up in active trading.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended sharply up in active trade on Monday, the first trading day after the Lunar New Year holiday, with buying focusing on textile stocks and shares with solid results records, brokers said.
The index gained 1.360 points or 2.03 percent to 68.209 points on volume of 24.9 million shares worth $11.7 million.
Brokers said the end of the two-week holiday brought more overseas buying to the market on Monday.
Trading on the Shanghai Stock Exchange resumed on Monday after a two-week lunar new year break.
